items: 【Make the Most of Your Space】2 Tier sofa table maximizes storage capacity, providing ample space for your belongings. With dimensions of 41.8”L x 11.5”W x 30.2”H, it fits snugly into any narrow area, using as entryway table, hallway table, foyer table, behind couch table and so on.

【Simple and Modern】The top of the console table adopts an exquisite splicing design, which combines beauty and practicality, adding a touch of elegance to your space. (Note: The wood board of top layer is imitation marble texture.)

【Sturdy and Durable】 Made of high-quality wood and heavy-duty metal, this hallway foyer table ensures exceptional durability for prolonged use. The X shaped frame further enhances stability of the entry table, ensuring reliability over time.
【Safety First】The behind couch table features 4 adjustable feet to prevent shaking on uneven surface and protect your floor from scratches, which make the hallway table stable and safe to use.
【Easy to Set up】Comprehensive instructions and numbered components are provided in the package, facilitating swift and effortless assembly of this console tables for entryway.
